# Tamworth Pest Quotes

> Pest control and termite inspection quotes in Tamworth, Calala, Hillvue, Kootingal and Manilla. A free referral service: one licensed local operator quotes for your job.

Tamworth Pest Quotes (pestcontroltamworth.com) is a free pest control referral service, not a pest control company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, pest type, property type, then contact details) and the request goes to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.

- Service: pest control, termite inspection and treatment, and pre-purchase timber pest inspection quotes
- Area: Tamworth, Tamworth Regional Council (NSW), including East Tamworth, West Tamworth, North Tamworth, South Tamworth, Hillvue, Westdale, Oxley Vale, Calala, Taminda, Nemingha, Kootingal, Moonbi, Hallsville, Moore Creek, Duri, Attunga, Manilla, Barraba, Woolomin, Bendemeer
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job
- Licensing: In NSW, anyone who applies pesticides for a fee or reward needs a pest management technician licence from the NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA). Termite and other timber pest treatments need a timber pest management technician licence. Licences are held by individual technicians and are listed on the EPA's public register.

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Tamworth Pest Quotes cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take pest control quote requests from Tamworth and nearby areas, including East Tamworth, West Tamworth, North Tamworth, South Tamworth, Hillvue, Westdale, Oxley Vale, Calala, Taminda, Nemingha, Kootingal, Moonbi, Hallsville, Moore Creek, Duri, Attunga, Manilla, Barraba, Woolomin, Bendemeer. Our referral service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. Ask the operator whether they charge for travel to rural properties.
- **Does a pest controller need a licence?** In NSW, anyone who applies pesticides for a fee or reward needs a pest management technician licence from the NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA). Termite and other timber pest treatments need a timber pest management technician licence. Licences are held by individual technicians and are listed on the EPA's public register.
- **What affects the price of pest control?** The pest, how widespread it is, the size and construction of the building, roof and subfloor access, and the treatment method. Termite work also depends on whether you need an inspection, a barrier, baiting or treatment of active termites. We don't publish prices. A local operator will quote for your job.
- **Who does the work?** Tamworth Pest Quotes is a free referral service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't carry out pest control. We pass your request to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.
